why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Juice app Go to the Juice Finance app , which the homepage links with its Launch app button.
2 Step 2 : Deposit ETH as collateral Use ETH as the collateral that unlocks leverage in USDB and ETH, the setup the homepage describes.
3 Step 3 : Deploy the leverage into point farming Put the leverage to work in farming points across the Blast ecosystem, which is how the campaign earns Blast Points and Gold for users.
4 Step 4 : Read the homepage for updates Return to the Juice Finance homepage to see whether the campaign notice changes, since the page carries no date.
